metadata.body:
# PoroTomo Induced-Seismicity Agent

Blueprint for clio-agent. The numeric work lives in plain scripts in this
repository so it can run on PBS compute nodes without an LLM:

- `agent/manifest.py`: list the DASV records on `s3://nrel-pds-porotomo/` and sample them.
- `agent/detect.py`: per-record detector (common-mode removal, 10-150 Hz band-pass, median STA/LTA).
- `agent/pbs/submit.sh`: submit the distributed detection plus aggregation job to Aurora.
- `agent/hazard.py`: anomaly z-scores, event catalogue, pumping volumes, seismogenic index, probabilities.

The experts orchestrate those scripts, inspect files, and explain results. They
never make up numbers. Every figure they report comes from `summary.json` or a
tool result.

Install by linking this directory into `~/.config/clio-agent/agent-blueprints/`.

agent_blueprint.name: PoroTomo IS (bench: digest)

session.title: porotomo-is-digest: Report the headline results of the agent

answer:
HEADLINE RESULTS — run /home/hyoklee/poro/agent/results/run_20261115T155359Z_s20 (read-only report; summary.json generated 2026-11-15T16:02:33+00:00; no PBS jobs submitted, no hazard.py run)

SCOPE / RECORDS ANALYSED
- 759 DAS records analysed (by_status: ok = 759), stride 20, covering 2016-03-18T02:09:17Z to 2016-03-26T00:59:44Z. Because of the stride-20 sampling, only sampled_fraction_of_time = 0.0331 (≈3.3%) of that window was examined; mean processing 2003.99 ms/record.

ANOMALIES AND DAS DETECTIONS
- Anomalous records: 57 of 759 (anomaly flag = z > 5.0). Top anomaly: start 2016-03-23T20:50:17Z, zmax 30.92, driver max_sta_lta (next: 2016-03-24T23:30:17Z zmax 24.99; 2016-03-25T00:30:17Z zmax 24.38, drivers max_sta_lta + spectral_centroid_hz; down to zmax 15.24).
- DAS detections: 62 events in 53 of the 759 records; scaled to full time window n = 1870.77. DAS relative-magnitude Aki MLE: b_relative = 0.98494, mc_relative = -0.84925; 34 events above mc_relative.
- Context: injection window 2016-03-11T08:00Z to 2016-03-27T07:00Z (15.96 days), injected 465,448 m³, extracted 505,933 m³, net injected -40,485 m³ (net extraction); 314,436 m³ injected during the DAS window. Hourly Spearman correlations of DAS events vs net injection / |Δnet| / injection: -0.173 / -0.030 / -0.093 (weak/negative). Background catalogue: GDR 859 LBNL/NCEDC March 2016, n = 5 events, mc = -0.48, mag_max ML 0.07.

SEISMOGENIC INDEX Sigma (Shapiro et al. 2021 Eq. 5 basis)
- Calibrated (LBNL catalogue): Sigma = -5.4489 (b=1.0), -5.3193 (b=0.73), -5.2809 (b=0.65).
- DAS-based upper bound: Sigma = -2.6983 at b_used = 0.98494 (DAS relative-magnitude Aki MLE).

P(Mw>=5.5) PER YEAR, by b scenario
- CALIBRATED — hazard_catalog_based (LBNL/NCEDC March 2016 catalogue, calibrated ML; p_per_year_at_observed_rate, M>=5.5):
  - b = 1.0: 0.00011982478978644906 (≈1.2e-4/yr)
  - b = 0.73: 0.004921548824626587 (≈4.9e-3/yr)
  - b = 0.65: 0.014735103451029574 (≈1.5e-2/yr)
  (For reference, same block, p_over_observed_volume M>=5.5: 5.24e-06 / 2.16e-04 / 6.48e-04 for b=1.0/0.73/0.65.)
- DAS-BASED UPPER BOUND — hazard_das_upper_bound (NOT calibrated): p_per_year_at_observed_rate M>=5.5 = 0.07842182774171746 (≈7.8e-2/yr); p_over_observed_volume M>=5.5 = 0.0024076054468051833.

WHICH IS CALIBRATED VS UPPER BOUND
- The hazard_catalog_based probabilities (Sigma ≈ -5.45 to -5.28; P(Mw>=5.5) ≈ 1.2e-4 to 1.5e-2 per year depending on b) are the CALIBRATED set: they rest on the LBNL/NCEDC March 2016 catalogue with calibrated local magnitudes (n=5, mc=-0.48, mag_max 0.07) and assumed b-values {1.0, 0.73, 0.65}.
- The hazard_das_upper_bound (Sigma = -2.6983; P(Mw>=5.5) ≈ 7.8e-2/yr) is a DAS-based UPPER BOUND with UNCALIBRATED magnitudes: it treats every DAS detection as an event at/above the catalogue minimum magnitude, so it over-counts, and its magnitudes are uncalibrated DAS relative magnitudes. It is not a calibrated probability.

ASSUMPTIONS EACH NUMBER RESTS ON
- Records/anomalies: stride-20 sampling covers only ≈3.3% of the 2016-03-18→2016-03-26 window; anomaly threshold z > 5.0.
- DAS events: 62 detections in 53/759 records; b_relative/mc_relative from Aki MLE on uncalibrated DAS relative magnitudes; full-window scaling uses the 1/0.0331 sampling factor.
- Calibrated hazard: small LBNL/NCEDC catalogue (n=5), observed stimulated volume V, Shapiro et al. (2021) Eq. 5, assumed b in {1.0, 0.73, 0.65}.
- DAS upper bound: every DAS detection counted as an event at/above catalogue mc — hence over-counting; uncalibrated magnitudes.
- Pumping/correlations: GDR 917 corrected deployment data (4 injection wells: 18D-31, 18B-31, 81A-1, 73-25; 5 extraction wells: 48A-1, 47C-1, 18-1, 27-1, 82A-11).
- Pohang reference block (context only): reported worst-case P(Mw 5.5) 0.15–0.17 for Sigma in [-2.0, -1.0], b in {0.65, 0.73}; Sigma needed at Brady for 1% Mw>=5.5 over observed volume: -2.166 (b=1.0), -3.651 (b=0.73), -4.091 (b=0.65) — i.e. Brady's calibrated Sigma (≈-5.3 to -5.4) is well below the level associated with Pohang-like hazard.
